utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina—those urgent fixes make sense. Could you share the full list so I can help coordinate it accurately?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll send over the full list of urgent fixes right now. If you want, I can also flag which ones need parts or a vehicle first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please flag which ones need parts or a vehicle first—that would help me coordinate more accurately.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Dane—I'll bring a shovel and some filler and we can take a look at the cracked edge and loose patch together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I can start at the tool table and sort the donated parts while you grab the shovel and filler.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll grab them and head over to the tool table after. See you in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let folks know you’re starting with the tool table. If anything changes, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, is the repair drive still happening today? I’d rather wait to head over until I know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, it’s still happening today — I’ll keep spreading the word. I’ll let folks know to head over when they’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m on the tool table and keeping things moving there. If anything changes, let me know and I’ll coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep you posted. The repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll check school run timing before confirming 10.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — Sunday at the community center works for me. Let me know once you confirm the 10 timing, and I’ll keep the tool table ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive set up yet—do you know where they’re taking donations?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now. I’ll check what’s still needed and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, that helps—I'll plan on the community center Sunday. Let me know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, Noah — anything you can donate or help fix would be great. Just swing by whenever you can, and I’ll pass the word along!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll swing by if I can. Just let me know if there’s anything specific you need me to bring or fix.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo. If you could check whether they still need tape and a couple of screwdrivers, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check and let you know. If they still need them, I can bring tape and a couple screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo. That sounds good—just let me know what you find out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve been hearing the repair drive is picking up steam—folks are already dropping off tools and supplies. If you want, I can ask around and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess—that’d be helpful. If you can find out what’s still needed and confirm the vehicle, I can plan around Tuesday after 3 or Thursday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and check what’s still needed, and I’ll confirm which vehicle they mean. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you help me go over the list and see what still needs attention? I’m trying to keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — send me the list and I’ll skim what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Rey — the donated items are right by the community hall entrance. Let me know if you need a hand getting started.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara. I’ll start by sorting the donated items by the community hall entrance.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — that’s a huge help. I’ll check back soon, and if you need anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, I’m out running errands but I’ll keep an ear out for any repair drive updates and let you know what I hear when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’m just hearing it’s moving along, and Gus said he can lend out tools and spare parts. If you hear anything else, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell — that’s great to hear. I’ll keep an ear out and check back in when I’m done running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, so that’s where donations will go now. If you want, I can go over the list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rosa—please do. I can still lend out tools and spare parts, so send anyone who needs them my way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Gus—thank you. I’ll point folks your way for tools and spare parts, and I’ll send over the current needs list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. I’m glad you can help spread the word, and I’ll let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Rosa. What time are you thinking for Sunday so I can work around the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m thinking 2 to 4 PM at the community center, so it should fit after the school day. Thanks again for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I saw the repair drive note—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, I’m a bit late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still catching up—what’s the main thing you need from me right now?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still catching up on the details, but I’m happy to help if there’s something specific needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — if you could help sort the donated tools and note what’s still missing, that’d be great. I’m a bit foggy on the list, so I can point you to the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can sort through the donated tools and jot down what’s missing. Just point me to the boxes, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — if you can spread the word and let folks know I’ve got tools and a few spare parts to lend, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus — I’ll pass it along if anyone needs tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Uli — I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that still works for me. If you can confirm the vehicle, I’ll plan around Tuesday after 3 or Thursday morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great—I'll check on the vehicle and get back to you. Tuesday after 3 or Thursday morning should work once I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli. Once you confirm the vehicle, just let me know which time is set and where to pick it up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. Just need a quick update on what items are still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive set up yet—do you know where they’re taking donations?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not sure yet—I'll check where they're collecting donations and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still waiting on the details, but I’ll pass them along as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course, Nell — just let me know when you have them, and I’ll spread the word right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s on Sunday now at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. I’ll bring whatever supplies I can find.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to know — Sunday at the community center it is. I’ll check on what’s still needed when I’m back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — just let me know what’s still needed when you’re back, and I’ll keep an eye out for supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Tuesday after 3 still works for me. I’m checking on a car or van now, and I’ll let you know if I can line up tools too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great, Mina — thanks for checking on the car or van and the tools. Keep me posted, and I’ll stay ready to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Will do — I’ll confirm the vehicle and tools as soon as I can. Thanks, Jules.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Hana — we still need a few tools, some volunteer hands, and help sorting the donated items. I’ll be by the community room if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ll help sort the donated items, and I can bring tape and a couple screwdrivers if you still need them. Is there a specific time you’d like me to come by the community room?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Hana — could you come by around 3? I’ll be in the community room then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Noah — I can check around and see if folks still need tape, screwdrivers, or any spare parts. I’ll pass along whatever I hear.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. Just let me know what people need and I’ll help if I can.
